title: Backend APIs & Application Architecture
tagline: Modular RESTful services & type-safe server architectures
description: Designing clean, maintainable server applications with structured data validation, predictable contracts, and secure access control.
deliverables: Type-safe RESTful API design using FastAPI and Express.js
Layered and package-by-feature organization adhering to clean code standards
Authentication and authorization with JWT tokens and session mechanisms
Centralized error handling, input sanitization, and structured responses

title: Background Workers & Resilient Workflows
tagline: Asynchronous task execution, state persistence, and queues
description: Orchestrating long-running jobs and multi-step workflows outside the HTTP request cycle with fault tolerance and recovery.
deliverables: Decoupling heavy tasks into asynchronous worker daemons
Step-level checkpointing and memoization for crash resilience
Database-backed task queues using PostgreSQL concurrency patterns
Automated retries, exponential backoff, and state machine transitions

title: Database Modeling, Normalization & Query Tuning
tagline: Normalized relational schemas, thoughtful indexing, and raw SQL
description: Architecting relational schemas with strong integrity, reducing redundancy through normalization, and optimizing query performance.
deliverables: Normalized schema design in PostgreSQL minimizing data anomalies
Purposeful B-Tree indexing on foreign keys and high-frequency query paths
Writing and optimizing raw SQL queries to eliminate full table scans
Integration of pgvector for similarity searches and vector embeddings

title: Full-Stack Implementation & Practical Deployment
tagline: Connecting APIs to modern frontends with Dockerized deploys
description: Bridging backend logic with responsive user interfaces and setting up predictable, reproducible container environments.
deliverables: Building responsive, component-driven user interfaces in Next.js and React
Dockerizing multi-service setups for reproducible development and testing
Managing Linux environments, Git workflows, and cloud deployments
Feature-sliced modular structuring for clean frontend maintainability
